blocks.goal: Extract protocol-related responsibility (storage and validation of allowed URL protocols) from Safelist into a cohesive SafelistProtocols class to reduce Safelist size and concentrate protocol logic.

ops.details: Create new class org.jsoup.safety.SafelistProtocols that encapsulates the protocols Map and operations that manage and validate allowed protocols. The new class will own: the protocols field (Map<TagName, Map<AttributeKey, Set<Protocol>>>), methods addProtocols(String tag, String attribute, String... protocols), removeProtocols(String tag, String attribute, String... removeProtocols), getProtocolValue(Element el, Attribute attr), isSafeProtocol(String value, Set<Protocol> protocols), and a helper hasProtocols(TagName tag, AttributeKey key) used by Safelist.shouldAbsUrl. The class will be placed in the same package (org.jsoup.safety). This extraction groups all protocol concerns into a single cohesive responsibility: managing protocol allowlists and protocol validation logic.

Move the private field 'protocols' from Safelist into the new SafelistProtocols class. Remove the field from Safelist. Ensure Safelist constructs and copies an instance of SafelistProtocols where previously the protocols map was copied.

inputs: src/main/java/org/jsoup/safety/Safelist.java:public Safelist addProtocols(String tag, String attribute, String... protocols)
outputs: src/main/java/org/jsoup/safety/SafelistProtocols.java:public SafelistProtocols addProtocols(String tag, String attribute, String... protocols)
ops.details: Move addProtocols implementation to SafelistProtocols. Adjust return type to allow chaining on SafelistProtocols. Safelist will expose the behavior by delegating to its SafelistProtocols instance where needed or will no longer have this method if chaining is routed via Safelist (UPDATE_CALL_SITES will adjust usages inside Safelist).

inputs: src/main/java/org/jsoup/safety/Safelist.java:public Safelist removeProtocols(String tag, String attribute, String... removeProtocols)
outputs: src/main/java/org/jsoup/safety/SafelistProtocols.java:public SafelistProtocols removeProtocols(String tag, String attribute, String... removeProtocols)
ops.details: Move removeProtocols implementation to SafelistProtocols. Adjust chaining return as appropriate for new class. Safelist internal call sites will be updated to use the new SafelistProtocols methods.

Move getProtocolValue to SafelistProtocols because it is only used to determine the protocol value for protocol validation. It will be made public (package-private or public) as needed so Safelist can call it. The implementation stays the same (uses el.absUrl and attr.getValue()).

Move isSafeProtocol implementation to SafelistProtocols since it operates solely on protocols data and normalizer functionality. The implementation will retain behavior (including anchor '#' support and lower-casing via Normalizer) and be exposed for Safelist to call.

Add required imports to the new class: java.util.Map, java.util.Set, java.util.HashMap, java.util.HashSet, org.jsoup.nodes.Element, org.jsoup.nodes.Attribute, and static import for org.jsoup.internal.Normalizer.lowerCase. Also import org.jsoup.safety.TypedValue.Protocol, TypedValue.TagName, TypedValue.AttributeKey.

Update Safelist to use the new SafelistProtocols instance. Changes include: remove direct references to the moved 'protocols' field and replace with calls to a new private final SafelistProtocols protocolPolicy field. Update constructors: instantiate protocolPolicy in the default constructor; update copy constructor to copy protocolPolicy (e.g., new SafelistProtocols(copy.protocolPolicy)). Replace usages in isSafeAttribute to obtain attrProts via protocolPolicy.getProtocolsForTag(TagName) or equivalent access method, and call protocolPolicy.getProtocolValue(el, attr) and protocolPolicy.isSafeProtocol(...). Update shouldAbsUrl(TagName, AttributeKey) to call protocolPolicy.hasProtocols(tag, key) instead of consulting the protocols map directly. Adjust any chaining return patterns if addProtocols/removeProtocols are chained from Safelist defaults by routing calls (e.g., Safelist.addProtocols(...) can internally call protocolPolicy.addProtocols(...) and return this) — within this block update only Safelist’s internal call sites so compilation is preserved.

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.
